title: Cosmic Heart Embrace
description: A surreal cosmic scene features a giant stylized female face in the starry purple sky, with a glowing fiery heart floating where her third eye would be. Below, two ornate golden and purple female figures stand in profile on the left while a whimsical green creature with large eyes and tentacles sits on the right, all framed by a large heart-shaped border.
prompt: Surreal cosmic fantasy scene with a giant stylized woman's face emerging from a starry purple nebula sky, a flaming golden heart floating in the center of her forehead, full red lips visible below. In the foreground, two ornate elegant female figures in golden and purple patterned robes stand in profile on the left, while a cute green tentacled creature with big round eyes sits on the right. The entire composition is framed by a large glowing heart-shaped border with decorative details, mystical and dreamlike atmosphere.
